campaign_id: qwen35-4b-w4a16 TP2 strict replication: resolving the 5.7% spread (2026-09-09 t3)
question: The 2026-09-07 t1 campaign measured the TP2 depth-3 strict pair at 240.615 and 227.533 tok/s. A 5.7% spread is well outside this host's documented ~3% back-to-back control drift, so the pair could not be quoted as a number. Two more fresh servers settle which value is real.
config: two B70s (mask 0,1), TP2, depth 3 via qwen3_5_mtp, draft INT4 head, FULL_DECODE_ONLY capture 1-64, determinism pad off, strict 12-prompt six-class realistic suite over completions, 512-token cap, class-balanced median tok/s over tokens 1-100 after TTFT

measurements.note: Four fresh servers per arm across two days and two host boots. t1 boot bf8e504b (2026-09-07), t3 boot fe4d4edd (2026-09-09).

finding.statement: 227.533 is an outlier, not a spread. Three of the four depth-3 passes fall in 240.615 to 241.182, a 0.24% band; the fourth sits 5.44% below it, beyond this host's ~3% drift bound. The operating number for TP2 depth 3 is 240.9 tok/s.
finding.corroboration: The MTP0 arm, measured the same four times across the same two days and boots, spans 137.853 to 138.169 - a 0.23% band. This lane's strict measurement is normally reproducible to a quarter of a percent, which is what makes the single 227.533 anomalous rather than characteristic.
finding.cause_of_the_outlier: Not determined. Nothing in t1's logs flags it: its postflights were clean and its gates passed. Recorded as an unexplained low pass rather than assigned a cause.

gates.reading: Eight strict servers across two campaigns, every comparison exact. TP2 depth 3 is lossless on this suite by the lane's own gate definition.

scaling.depth3: TP1 177.4 -> TP2 240.9 tok/s, 1.36x on two cards
scaling.note: The speed-up is the same with and without speculation, so the second card is not helping or hurting the draft path specifically.

status_and_scope: Evidence only, per the campaign's agreed scope. families/qwen-4b.json still lists tp: [1] and packages/qwen35-4b-w4a16-b70 is a one-card packet. TP2 now has four strict passes across two days and two boots, all gates exact, and a settled throughput number, so it is ready to be added as a dimension whenever the owner wants that - which is a packaging decision, not a measurement one, and was explicitly out of scope tonight.
